Package frc.robot

Interface Constants.HardwareDefaults

Enclosing interface:
Constants
public static interface Constants.HardwareDefaults
Starting gains for the library's real-hardware subsystems.

These are a starting point, not tuning advice. They are sized so a plausible mechanism moves under control on first run; every team must tune on their own hardware with their own feedforward, because gains depend on gearing, mass, and friction that this library cannot know.

They live here rather than being read from a global inside the control loop, so the subsystem that uses them is the only thing that depends on them and a team can override them by calling setGains(...) or by subclassing.

    • ELEVATOR_KS

      static final double ELEVATOR_KS
      Static gain for ElevatorSubsystem's feedforward, in volts.

      The voltage needed to overcome the mechanism's own friction at rest. Zero by default: this library cannot know a team's friction, and guessing high would make the carriage creep. A team should characterise this on their hardware.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

      static final double ELEVATOR_KV
